trainer.leader_water.intro: The fjord gives and the fjord takes. Let us see what it takes from you.
trainer.leader_water.defeated: You sail well against the wind. The Fjord badge is yours.
trainer.arena3_junior.name: Fisher Karen
trainer.arena3_junior.intro: Ingrid is down by the slipway. First you get past my nets!
trainer.arena3_junior.defeated: You slipped through the mesh. Go on down to the water.
poi.arena3.name: Stige Ø arena
trainer.leader_grove.name: Forester Asger
trainer.leader_grove.intro: Every branch here holds a fairy tale. Yours may end today.
trainer.leader_grove.defeated: What a story. The Fairy-tale Forest badge is yours.
trainer.arena4_junior.name: Scout Mads
trainer.arena4_junior.intro: Asger waits among the trees. Can you find your way past me?
trainer.arena4_junior.defeated: Good tracking! Follow the path into the forest.
poi.arena4.name: H.C. Andersen Skoven arena
trainer.leader_spirit.name: Sculptor Mette
trainer.leader_spirit.intro: The statues in the park see everything. Tonight they see you lose.
trainer.leader_spirit.defeated: You stand like granite. The Sculpture badge is yours.
trainer.arena5_junior.name: Miller Ane
trainer.arena5_junior.intro: The mill grinds and I fight. Mette is up by the manor.
trainer.arena5_junior.defeated: Finely ground! Go up to the sculptures.
poi.arena5.name: Hollufgård arena
trainer.leader_fire.name: Smith Niels
trainer.leader_fire.intro: The forge is hot and the hammer is ready. Step into the smithy!
trainer.leader_fire.defeated: You are forged from the right stuff. The Village badge is yours.
trainer.arena6_junior.name: Baker Lars
trainer.arena6_junior.intro: The oven is lit, and so am I! Niels is at the smithy.
trainer.arena6_junior.defeated: Burnt. Go on to the smithy.
poi.arena6.name: Den Fynske Landsby arena
trainer.leader_mixed.name: Keeper Fatima
trainer.leader_mixed.intro: I look after animals from all over the world. Yours won’t be the first to lose.
trainer.leader_mixed.defeated: What a team you have gathered. The Zoo badge is yours.
trainer.arena7_junior.name: Guide Yasmin
trainer.arena7_junior.intro: Welcome to the tour! First stop: a battle.
trainer.arena7_junior.defeated: The tour ends here. Fatima is waiting by the entrance.
poi.arena7.name: Odense Zoo arena
trainer.leader_storm.name: Weatherwatcher Bo
trainer.leader_storm.intro: From up here you can see the storm coming. Today the storm is me.
trainer.leader_storm.defeated: The storm has passed. The Hilltop badge is yours, champion!
trainer.arena8_junior.name: Runner Freja
trainer.arena8_junior.intro: I run up this hill every day. Can you keep up?
trainer.arena8_junior.defeated: Catch your breath. Bo is waiting at the top.
